instructions:
1. Sit on a bench and grip the front edge near your hips.
2. Walk your feet forward and straighten your legs, keeping heels on the floor.
3. Lift your hips off the bench and support your weight on your hands.
4. Bend your elbows straight back and lower your hips until your arms reach 90 degrees.
5. Press through your hands to straighten your arms and lift back up.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your elbows pointing back, not flaring out, to load the triceps.
2. Stay close to the bench to protect your shoulders.
3. Lower under control and avoid dropping into the bottom.
4. Exhale as you press up.

instructions:
1. Stand next to a wall.
2. Raise one arm to shoulder height and bend the elbow to 90 degrees.
3. Place your forearm and palm flat against the wall.
4. Turn your torso slowly away from the wall until you feel a stretch across your chest.
5. Hold, then switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your shoulder down and away from your ear.
2. Rotate the torso slowly to control the stretch depth.
3. Stop at a mild stretch, not pain.
4. Breathe deeply and steadily.

instructions:
1. Start on your hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
2. Keeping the right knee bent at 90 degrees, lift the leg back and up until the thigh is in line with your torso.
3. Lower the knee back to the start.
4. Lift the right knee out to the side until the thigh is parallel to the floor.
5. Lower the knee back to the start, then switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Squeeze the glute at the top of each kick.
2. Keep your back flat and head neutral, looking at the floor.
3. Move slowly and avoid swinging the leg.
4. Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with arms out to the sides in a T shape.
2. Bend your knees and lift your feet so the thighs are vertical.
3. Keeping shoulders flat, lower both knees to one side.
4. Bring the knees back to the center.
5. Lower both knees to the opposite side, then return to center.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep both shoulders flat on the floor throughout.
2. Move slowly and with control to protect your back.
3. Lower the knees only as far as your shoulders stay down.
4. Exhale as you twist, inhale as you return.

instructions:
1. Lie on your back on the floor with arms out to the sides in a T shape.
2. Rest your bent legs on top of a stability ball.
3. Keeping shoulders flat, roll your knees and the ball to one side.
4. Bring the knees and ball back to the center.
5. Roll to the opposite side, then return to center.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep both shoulders flat on the floor throughout.
2. Control the ball so it does not roll away from you.
3. Move slowly to engage the obliques and protect your back.
4. Exhale as you twist, inhale as you return.
